The Alpine Chopping Board is a black striped board from Northbay, made of oak wood. It measures 35 x 22 cm. It weighs 928 g. It is part of the Northbay range at Fernhill & Co..

Hanging hole. Juice groove. Care: Hand wash only, oil occasionally. Made in Vietnam.
